args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 February.
- A saved report still carries the old label, 'Covey — Late Arrivals', so supervisors searching for the account are finding it under the wrong name.
- Please treat 'Covey' as the same account as Pellow Home Living when you match records.
- Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team) is handling the report relabel. Tell her if you need anything from the deal desk side.

Thanks,
Sofia (drafted by assistant)

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

PHL label cleanup:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'. It needs relabelling; the owner is still to be confirmed.
- Please treat 'Covey' and Pellow Home Living as the same account when matching records.
- 'PHL' is shared by two businesses. Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. Pellucid rows (Pellucid Harbor Logistics) are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.

Thanks
